title.narrative: Ukraine's civil society, business community, and media supported in their efforts to promote a culture of integrity in the management of public affairs.

No. of additional people reached by CSO Projects in the areas of strenghening the role of investigative media, business and civil society in addressing corruption, accountability and transparency due to EUACI support
Increased production of investigative content, that expose malpractices, vested interests and corruption at central, regional and local levels.
Number of articles and news clips produced with support from the Regional Press Development Institute
No. of Projects identified and supported with EUACI funding
Criminal Analysis and Crime Information (Data) Management Systems modernized
No. of data sources added to the Data Warehouse
NABU performing effectively according to its mandate
No. of standard and complex cases handed over to te High Anti-Corruption Court (HACC)
Status (Progress) on e-Case Management System implementation and operationalisation

target.value: All new cases put into the e-Case Management System. Only limited number of documents are printed.

actual.value: Electronic Case Management continued to work in product mode. Currently 340 criminal cases being processed in eCase

target.value: e-Case Management System developed and customised

actual.value: Electronic Case Management system for NABU, SAPO and HACC developed and customised. The EUACI assisted NABU, SAPO and HACC in piloting the system on a step-by-step approach, with a gradual involvement of all stakeholders. Legislative framework is to be adopted by Verkhovna Rada and secondary legislation by other stakeholders to enable usage of the system.

target.value: e-Case Management System launched into industrial operation

actual.value: Electronic Case Management system launched into industrial operation as of 16 December 2021 after adoption of secondary legislation approved by NABU, SAPO, PGO, Council of Judges and HACC.

actual.value: The MIP was approved in 3 out of 5 partner cities
